frozenBy: roadmap step 0.4; decisions D22-D25; sample plan v1.1
rule: This table is frozen before training. Changing any threshold after seeing evaluation results is forbidden; a change requires a new gate version, a decision-register entry, and a fresh evaluation.
evaluatedOn: held-out manual in-domain sample only (docs/dataset/sample-plan.md); public-dataset results are reported separately as transfer evidence, never as the gate
confidenceIntervals: 95% reported for every metric; the gate is a point-estimate check with intervals disclosed
languageFailureLadder: SIGNALS_ONLY (descriptive validated signals only, no score, engine labelled)
UNKNOWN (reason code; never a fabricated number)

en.determinism: identical output for identical input and model version; full result hashed
en.latencyProfile: 10-review batch, 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM, CPU-only, warm model

fr.determinism: identical output for identical input and model version; full result hashed
fr.latencyProfile: 10-review batch, 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM, CPU-only, warm model

notes: AUPRC is reported with the class balance of the evaluation set stated.
F1 at p_organic = 0.50 is an operating point, not a deployed threshold.
A reliability curve is shown in the report alongside ECE.
English may pass while French fails; languages are gated independently (D13).
The manual sample is never used for adaptation, feature selection, threshold tuning, or calibration.
